title: Un Long Voyage
identity: Billaudot identifies Un long voyage as a short fantasy for alto, soprano or tenor saxophone and piano, copyright 2013, 4:30. Publisher text says it is inspired by the French children’s song “Il était un petit navire” and covers technical elements expected in a first-cycle learner. It labels the work Easy, Cycle 1.
